findings.claim: The closed CP-12 registry does not define an explicit allowed recovery edge or destination out of CHARGED_ACCOUNTING_BLOCKED after bounded reconciliation, and it likewise does not define the destination out of ADMISSION_ACCOUNTING_BLOCKED; the phrase exact bounded reconciliation is not a closed state transition.
findings.evidence_excerpt: `ADMISSION_ACCOUNTING_BLOCKED`, `CHARGED_ACCOUNTING_PENDING`, `CHARGED_ACCOUNTING_BLOCKED`, or `COMPLETION_INDEX_CLOSE_PENDING` | exact bounded reconciliation; any charged writer/accounting/APPLIED-completion failure uses `CHARGED_ACCOUNTING_PENDING→CHARGED_ACCOUNTING_BLOCKED`
findings.impact: An implementation cannot determine the sole post-reconciliation destination or authorization for a blocked accounting state and may invent a return to pending, dispatch, or terminal handling; that leaves the claimed exhaustive CP/P3/P15 closure unable to prevent an accounting bypass or indefinite charged state.
findings.recommended_action: Add explicit CP-12 allowed edges and destinations for pre-charge and charged accounting-blocked recovery, including remaining-allocation, exhaustion, failure, and terminal-reconciliation cases, then bind each edge to Section 14 coverage, P3/P15 rules, authorization pairs, and fixtures.

findings.claim: PostChargeRecoveryAllocation is specified as permitting only a guarded same-attempt transition to FAILED_CHARGED_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, while Section 9.1 requires candidate-equal missing-receipt and charged-completion-corruption recoveries to terminate at FAILED_CHARGED_PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN and FAILED_CHARGED_COMPLETION_CORRUPT; the design provides no explicit allocation/authorization path for those required terminals when the original reservation is exhausted.
findings.evidence_excerpt: The allocation can authorize only outcome observation, exceptional recovery completion/CLOSE and a guarded same-attempt transition to `FAILED_CHARGED_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED`; it cannot complete the original success path, dispatch or accept.
findings.impact: A charged attempt with no remaining reservation units can enter the Section 9.1 provenance or completion-corruption blocked states but has no declared funded terminal path, forcing either permanent blockage or an undeclared allocation/transition and undermining exact terminal closure and charge accounting.
findings.recommended_action: Explicitly include the provenance-unknown and charged-completion-corrupt terminal recoveries in the closed PostChargeRecoveryAllocation effect set, with both-ceiling checks, D/B recurrence, HUMAN authority, exact pair IDs, P3/P15 edges, and fixtures; or define an equally closed alternative without permitting READY, dispatch, acceptance, reuse, or a new attempt.
